summary_1line: Uluka repeats Duryodhana’s insults; the enraged Pandavas vow terrible vengeance, with Bhima swearing to kill Duryodhana and drink Dussasana’s blood.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima rises in fury, gnashing his teeth and glaring at Uluka while warriors around him leap up with red eyes and raised arms.
The Pandava warriors—Dhrishtadyumna, Satyaki, the twins, and others—spring from their seats, arms gleaming with gold ornaments and red sandal paste in anger.
Arjuna wipes sweat from his brow in a hall of tense kings while Uluka stands before them delivering Duryodhana’s taunts.
